title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) CRIME IN INDIA - 1999 3.7.4.2 Among the specified purpose or causes, marriage (9682), illicit intercourse (2033) ransom (1243) and un-lawful activity (781) were the significant causes. In percentage terms the above causes accounted for 40.6 percent, 8.5 percent, 5.2 percent and 3.3 percent. Of the total victims reported under this crime head. Of the total Kidnapping & Abduction victims 66.9 percent were females (15,956). Among the total female victims, the females who were kidnapped and abducted for ‘illicit intercourse’ (1960), ‘for marriage’ (9159) and for prostitution (227) purposes and accounted for 71.1 percent. For the male victims Ransom (1220) was the major reason in Kidnapping & Abduction. This was followed by, the causes ‘Revenge’ (812), Unlawful Activity (539) and ‘For Marriage’ (523). The above 4 causes accounted for 39.1 percent the total male victims reported under this crime.
